title.zh: 【Ripple 扩大与纽约银行在托管和代币化贸易融资领域的战略合作】
title.en: 【Ripple 扩大与纽约银行在托管和代币化贸易融资领域的战略合作】

current_state.zh:
Ripple 扩大与纽约银行（BNY）的战略合作，旨在拓展机构数字资产托管能力，并探索区块链技术在机构领域的新应用场景，包括代币化贸易融资。此次合作将 Ripple 的数字资产解决方案和公共区块链 XRP Ledger 与 BNY 的规模、服务模式和数字化能力相结合。

这一安排将大型托管银行与公共区块链网络结合，扩展了机构数字资产托管范围，并推动代币化贸易融资向商业测试阶段迈进。BNY 自身的分析认为，随着法律框架与区块链创新的推进，代币化贸易融资正逐步接近商业现实。

Ripple 与 BNY 表示，双方计划在 XRP Ledger 上推进代币化贸易融资，具体取决于客户需求。代币化贸易融资将应收账款等既有贸易融资资产以数字形式表示，有望扩大投资者参与范围，并简化相关资产的管理与分销方式。
current_state.en: Ripple expanded its strategic partnership with BNY to broaden institutional digital asset custody capabilities and explore tokenized trade finance using Ripple's solutions and the XRP Ledger.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ripple expanded its strategic partnership with BNY to broaden institutional digital asset custody capabilities and explore tokenized trade finance using Ripple's solutions and the XRP Ledger.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ripple expanded its strategic partnership with BNY to broaden institutional digital asset custody capabilities and explore tokenized trade finance using Ripple's solutions and the XRP Ledger.
updates.background_zh: XRP Ledger 是创建于 2012 年的开源、无需许可的区块链，其原生数字资产为 XRP。BNY 曾发布关于贸易融资资产代币化的研究，认为新的法律框架与区块链创新正使代币化贸易融资更接近商业现实。
updates.background_en: The XRP Ledger is an open-source, permissionless blockchain created in 2012, with XRP as its native digital asset. BNY has published research on tokenization of assets in trade finance, arguing that new legal frameworks and blockchain innovation are bringing tokenized trade finance closer to commercial reality.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该公告将 XRP 与 XRP Ledger 同具有系统重要性的托管银行联系起来，为机构托管和代币化贸易融资提供了直通 XRP Ledger 基础设施的渠道。机构资金流向是否发生变化，最终取决于客户对这些所公布能力的实际采用，而非公告本身。
updates.market_impact_en: The announcement ties XRP and the XRPL to a systemically important custodian bank, giving institutional custody and tokenized trade finance a direct channel to XRP Ledger infrastructure. Any eventual shift in institutional flows would depend on client adoption of the announced capabilities rather than the announcement itself.
